title: Version 1.26.0
body:
Version 1.26.0

July 17th, 2023

Added:

  • Added item turntable
  • Added vehicle turntable
  • Added new secret vinyl
  • Added extra maps around the area

Changes:

  • More changes to explosives
  • Moved the skull rock to the desert

Bug Fixes:

  • More fixes for crates
  • Fixed collision with easter event gift

Version 1.26.1

July 18th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed a bug with the pedestals
  • Attempted fix of the crate issue

Version 1.26.2

July 18th, 2023
